string_agreement_before.label_source: stored entity_ontology_label (belongs to the OLD ids)

string_agreement_after.label_source: freshly re-fetched authority labels for the repaired ids

adjudication.unadjudicated_reason: one batch was declined by the adjudicating model; not re-worded or re-split. Handled by a deterministic label-token-containment check (11/15 contained) and bounded.
adjudication.parse_completeness: asserted: every adjudicated batch item returned a parsable verdict
adjudication.note: adjudicated errors were then NULLED, so they are not present in the delivered table
adjudication.provenance_note: 16 rows (9 pairs) were flagged DIFFERENT by model adjudication = 0.51%. 1 further row ('Alpha-1 adrenergic receptor (ADRA1) autoantibody' -> HGNC:278 labelled ADRA1B) was flagged by my own deterministic label-token-containment check, NOT by the adjudicator. Headline 0.55% is the conservative union of both (17/3110); 0.51% is the model-adjudicated-only rate. Worst case 1.03% adds the 15 rows in the declined batch.

tierA_gating.finding: gene_marker does not always describe entity (e.g. entity=ACLY with gene_marker=ELP1), so Tier A was gated on entity correspondence rather than trusted wholesale

source_label_note: GO rows carry ontology_id_source='authority_lookup_GO' (OLS4 ontology=go); authority_lookup_C is CHEBI-only. An earlier draft conflated the two.
